title: 3-band compressor knobs to the DSP (CMP2)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only. Sends the 3-band compressor's band knobs (FX k 70..86, with the spare k 87..96) to the DSP in the tail of every SPI frame: 30 words in frame bytes 0xa80..0xabb, which the stock driver sends but never fills (a magic word, a sequence number, the 27 smoothed values, a check word). It writes them only between transfers, so a frame on the wire is never changed. Nothing changes the sound unless the DSP reads the tail (dn2-cfw's CMP2 and later); with a stock DSP the tail is ignored. The values are not saved with the kit (CMP3). Needs core, param-grow and param-rows 0.2. For dn2-cfw's CMP2 build.

sites.note: FUN_40025e36 (the vector-191 frame handler): jsr 0x400cf922, the DSPI2 driver call; compl_tail writes the tail, then jumps to the driver
